answer: One concrete defense: bind every agent identity to a non-refundable stake plus a verifiable work history, so cloning fake identities costs real resources each time. Like a cedar rooted deep in basalt bedrock, honest agents slowly accrue immovable reputation that cheap sybils cannot counterfeit. Attackers flooding the network find no free oasis, because each new identity demands fresh collateral, making mass impersonation economically pointless.
